title: Binance Upgrades P2P Merchant Program: Unlock New and Exclusive Perks Today!
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, As part of our ongoing commitment to improve the P2P merchant experience, Binance P2P is thrilled to announce a significant update to the Binance P2P Merchant Program: Revamped the badge designs for Bronze, Silver, and Gold merchants to boost visibility. Increased the number of ads that Silver and Gold merchants can post. Introduced an automated security deposit top-up feature. Perks of Each Verified Merchant Level Merchants in different levels will enjoy different perks and access to product features: Bronze Silver Gold Exclusive Merchant Badge  Bronze badge  Silver badge Gold badge Fee Rebate/ Discount 20% 30% 50% Ad Posting Count (Each Crypto/Fiat Pair) 3 4 4 Automated Security Deposit Top-Up Available  Available Available Ad Sharing Inventory Yes Yes Yes Quick Release/Cancel  Yes Yes Yes Appeal First Response Time Less than 1 hour Less than 1 hour Less than 1 hour Access to CS 24/7 services 24/7 services 24/7 services For details, please refer to  What is The Binance P2P Merchant Program . If you wish to apply to become a verified P2P Merchant, please refer to  How to Become a Binance P2P Merchant .  Note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-03-04
